verdict.rationale: Undermind offers automation-like features, such as saved-topic alerts and batch or programmatic queries, so asking whether those can be versioned, reviewed and rolled back is a fair question. The evidence pack documents no versioning, change review or rollback for any of them. The vendor reference also states there is no versioning or changelog surface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
